test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the speed of a boat in still water if the boat goes 12 km/h along the stream and 4 km/h against the stream.
solution: Given: Distance covered in downstream = 12 km/h Distance covered in upstream = 4 km/h Concept used: Downstream speed = (x + y) km/h Upstream speed = (x - y) km/h
